text:
maria: :rotating_light: chi1 hosted inference - sudden 502 spike, multiple customers reporting auth failures and long tail latencies. seeing 502/gateway errors across multiple tenants. @ravi can you triage? links: https://grafana.redwood/chi1/hosted-api

infra-bot: Alert: hosted-api 502 error rate increased in chi1 (svc=hosted-api) — 10m avg 4.3% -> 18.9% (triggered at 2026-03-17T12:34:20Z)

ravi: oncall checking dashboards + logs. starting runbook for regional networking incident. grabbing pcap and egress metrics.

emma: tcpdump from chi1-edge0 egress to provider-64512 shows retransmits + dup acks. sample: ```12:34:32.123456 IP chi1-edge > provider: Flags [P.], seq 12345:12485, ack 9876, win 64240, length 140
12:34:32.124112 IP provider > chi1-edge: Flags [R.], seq 9876, ack 12485, win 0, length 0
12:34:32.125000 IP chi1-edge > provider: Retransmission, seq 12345:12485, ack 9876```

liam: Carrier (provider-64512) reported a BGP route flap originating in their POP in CHI1 around 12:33 UTC — AS path prepends and a transient withdraw observed. could be causing microbursts and egress queueing. I've opened the carrier ticket and they're investigating.

alex: Customer repro (from us-east client): `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway, body: "gateway timeout", header X-Request-Id: abc123. Happened on three separate requests within 30s.

maria: Customers affected: #12345 (SaaS app), #12346 (internal partner). both report failed calls and charging uncertainty. escalating to support ops for refunds if needed.

emma: I applied temporary egress steering for chi1-hosted-api to alternate carrier (provider-64513) at 12:52 UTC. p99 latency dropped from ~4.2s to ~260ms for test traffic. keeping monitoring on.

ravi: motion to enable cross-az fallback for hosted-api in chi region while carrier stabilizes. this will route traffic to chi2/chi3 on failure. tagging infra leads for approval.

liam: Carrier pushed a rollback to their routing policy at 12:50 UTC, they expect stabilization within 5-10m but will continue to monitor for repeated withdraws.

infra-bot: Mitigation applied: `egress-steer-alt-provider=true` for chi1-hosted-api at 2026-03-17T12:52:18Z by emma. Monitoring rule: alert if 502 rate > 5% for 5m.

alex: Post-mitigation quick check: repeating the repro curl now returns 200 and generation tokens consumed correctly. auth errors + 502s dropped in logs for the last 10m.

maria: I'll update customers and mark urgent tickets for follow-up. owners for postmortem: emma (runtime), liam (network), ravi (oncall). thanks everyone :thumbsup:

emma: saving pcaps + graphs to incident folder: s3://incidents/chi1/1799999999/ ; will start draft postmortem after carrier confirms no further flaps.

ravi: leaving this thread open until carrier confirms. if 502s resurge, we'll escalate to platform pager and consider automatic cross-az fallback enabled by default.

maria: closing urgent customer comms, will send out a status update in 15m.
